approvalEvidence: The project owner confirmed a complete review of the application's religious content and all user-facing features on 2026-08-31 and accepted them as correct without requiring an external signature.
notes: quran.json is the immutable canonical Tanzil text. On 2026-10-07, at the project owner's direction, the 112 ayah-1 basmalah prefixes removed on 2026-08-24 were restored by restoring the original verbatim import; every ayah text again matches the source exactly (canonicalTextSha256). The basmalah is separated at runtime only (lib/core/quran/quran_basmalah.dart); no tool or feature may modify the file. Future religious-content changes require project-owner reconfirmation of the affected content, but do not create an external-sheikh signature requirement.
